style: The first attached image sets the painterly look: its soft brushwork, its clouds, its colours, its painted toy fortress with cream walls, square battlements and orange roofs. The second attached image sets the title lettering only. Take nothing else from them. The title Grid Cannons is large and clear, in the lettering of the second attached image, placed where the painting is quietest, and it covers no building, no cannon and no flag. Every shot is physically right: the cannon's barrel points at its target, the smoke plume leaves the muzzle along the barrel, and the cannonball flies on from the muzzle in a shallow arc toward the target. Painted 2D illustration, not a 3D render. No people, no other words, no watermark.

directions.scene: Paint a Steam capsule key-art illustration of the toy fortress island seen from high above at a three-quarter angle, as the first attached image shows it, but with the island in the lower two thirds of the frame and the upper third fading into one flat warm sky colour with a few soft painterly clouds, where the title goes, above the keep and its flag and touching nothing. Three bronze cannons on the sea-facing wall; only the middle one fires, a big white smoke plume and a visible cannonball flying out over the sea; a sailing ship with striped sails small and far on the right. A faint painted tile grid on the grass.

Paint a Steam capsule key-art illustration of two toy fortress islands seen from high above at a three-quarter angle, each with cream walls, square battlements, orange roofs and a keep with a flag, the left one with a red flag, the right one with a blue flag, facing each other across a strait of blue sea, each about a third of the frame wide and both large. A cannon on the left fortress fires one shot: a big white smoke plume and a visible cannonball in a shallow arc across the strait toward the right fortress. The upper quarter of the frame fades into one flat sky colour with soft painterly clouds, where the title goes. A faint painted tile grid on the grass of both islands. No ships.

Paint a Steam capsule key-art illustration of a green land map seen from high above at a three-quarter angle, a faint painted tile grid over the grass, with two toy fortresses on it, cream walls, square battlements, orange roofs, a keep with a flag each, the near one bottom left with a red flag and the far one top right with a blue flag, a sand path and a small river between them, round trees and rocks. A cannon on the near fortress fires one shot: a big white smoke plume and a visible cannonball in a shallow arc toward the far fortress. The top of the frame fades into one flat sky colour with soft painterly clouds, where the title goes. No sea, no ships.

Paint a Steam capsule key-art illustration from high above at a three-quarter angle: the player's toy fortress large in the lower left, cream walls, square battlements, orange roofs, a keep with a red flag, on its green island with a faint painted tile grid; the enemy fortress smaller in the upper right across a bay of blue sea, with a blue flag. One cannon on the near fortress fires: a big white smoke plume at its muzzle and a visible cannonball in a shallow arc across the bay toward the enemy. The upper left of the frame is quiet sky fading into one flat colour with soft painterly clouds, where the title goes.

Paint a Steam capsule key-art illustration in two parts: the top 35 percent of the frame is one flat solid sky-blue band with nothing in it but the title; below it the painting, the toy fortress island from high above at a three-quarter angle as in the first attached image, cream walls, square battlements, orange roofs, a keep with a red flag, three bronze cannons on the sea-facing wall, the middle one firing a big white smoke plume and a visible cannonball out over the sea, a faint painted tile grid on the grass, a sailing ship small and far. The painting's sky meets the flat band with a soft painterly edge.

Paint a Steam capsule key-art illustration of two toy fortress islands facing each other across a strait of blue sea, seen from high above at a three-quarter angle, cream walls, square battlements, orange roofs, keeps with a red and a blue flag, both large in the frame, at evening: a low warm sun, long soft shadows, the sky fading at the top into one flat warm cream-orange colour with soft painterly clouds, where the title goes. A cannon on the left fortress fires one shot with a bright muzzle flash, a big white smoke plume and a visible cannonball in a shallow arc toward the right fortress. A faint painted tile grid on the grass. No ships.

Paint a Steam capsule key-art illustration from above and a little closer: two toy fortress corners face each other across a narrow channel of blue sea, the left one with a red flag, the right one with a blue flag, the walls big, cream with square battlements, orange roofs behind them. One bronze cannon on the left wall fires a huge white smoke plume and a visible cannonball in a shallow arc across the channel at the right wall. The upper third of the frame is open sky fading into one flat colour with soft painterly clouds, where the title goes, touching no wall.

Paint a Steam capsule key-art illustration in the gouache look with soft painted outlines of the first attached image: the toy fortress island from high above at a three-quarter angle filling the lower two thirds of the frame, cream walls, square battlements, orange roofs, a keep with a red flag, three bronze cannons on the sea-facing wall, only the middle one firing a big white smoke plume and a visible cannonball out over the sea, a faint painted tile grid on the grass, a sailing ship small and far. The upper third fades into one flat warm sky colour with soft clouds, where the title goes.

Paint a Steam capsule key-art illustration of the toy fortress island from high above at a three-quarter angle, as the first attached image shows it, in the lower two thirds of the frame, cream walls, square battlements, orange roofs, a keep with a red flag, a faint painted tile grid on the grass. An exchange of fire: an enemy cannonball from off the right edge has just hit the outer wall, a small burst of white dust and three loose stone blocks tumbling, and the middle of three cannons on that wall fires back with a big white smoke plume and a visible cannonball flying out to the right. The upper third fades into one flat warm sky colour with soft painterly clouds, where the title goes.

Paint a Steam capsule key-art illustration of the toy fortress island seen from high above at a three-quarter angle, as the first attached image shows it, with the island in the lower two thirds of the frame and the upper third fading into one flat warm sky colour with a few soft painterly clouds, where the title goes in the white capitals with the soft outline of the second attached image, made larger, above the keep and its flag and touching nothing. Three bronze cannons on the sea-facing wall; only the middle one fires, a big white smoke plume and a visible cannonball flying out over the sea; a sailing ship with striped sails small and far on the right. A faint painted tile grid on the grass.
